thesis: The bear carried the debate because the current evidence shows an exceptionally large gap between revenue and losses/free-cash-flow burn, while the bullish case still depends on project conversion that is not binding or financed in the available data. Certification, liquidity, and nuclear demand are valuable counterweights, but they do not create a current earnings or cash-flow floor.
strongest_counterexample: NuScale could convert its certified design and TVA/Romania pathways into a definitive, financed offtake program before liquidity becomes a constraint; that would validate the strategic value of the platform and make the present revenue snapshot look backward-looking rather than representative.
invalidation_conditions: Two consecutive quarterly reports show revenue above $50M, quarterly operating loss below 50% of revenue, and free-cash-flow burn below $100M; this would invalidate the bearish operating thesis.

NuScale signs a definitive, financed offtake or deployment agreement with disclosed timing and economics sufficient to cover a material portion of development costs; this would invalidate the bearish commercialization thesis.
The share price reclaims SMA-200 near $13.47 and holds above it for 20 trading sessions with a positive MACD histogram; this would invalidate the bearish technical component.
evidence_gaps: No binding TVA or Romanian power-purchase agreement, project financing, price, or deployment schedule is available.
Total debt, cash-runway duration, restricted-cash composition, and diluted-share-count trajectory are not fully provided.
No multi-period revenue, margin, operating-loss, or free-cash-flow trend is available beyond the current snapshot.
No current consensus-estimate revision series is available.
decisive_factors: Revenue is $31.5M against a $355.8M net loss and -$460.1M free cash flow.
Operating and net margins are approximately -2,190.6% and -1,130.3%.
Dated news confirms certification, liquidity, and project milestones but not bankable cash conversion.
Price is below SMA-200 after an 83.0% drawdown even though short-term momentum is improving.
